chen2012.title: Follow Whom? Chinese Users Have Different Choice (arXiv:1212.0167, cs.SI)
chen2012.author: Zhaoqun Chen, Pengfei Liu, Xiaohan Wang, Yuantao Gu
chen2012.quote: This work is based on a data set of Sina Weibo which contains 80.8 million users' profiles and 7.2 billion relations and a large data set of Twitter. … Coinciding with Asian traditional culture, the following preference of Sina Weibo users is more concentrated and hierarchical: they are more likely to follow people at higher or the same social levels and less likely to follow people lower than themselves. In contrast, the same kind of following preference is weaker in Twitter.
supports: 80.8 million Sina Weibo profiles
7.2 billion follow relations
Weibo's following preference is more concentrated and hierarchical than Twitter's
two passages from the same abstract, joined by an ellipsis

fuwen2017.title: 新浪微博如何应对极端峰值下的弹性扩容挑战 (How Sina Weibo meets the elastic-scaling challenge under extreme peaks) — talk writeup
fuwen2017.author: 付稳 (Fu Wen), 新浪微博技术专家, 微博混合云 DCP 项目技术负责人
fuwen2017.quote: 白百何出轨、李晨范冰冰在一起等热点事件，突发性强无预期 … 如何在十分钟内完成 1000 节点扩容能力
supports: Weibo splits its load into the annual Spring Festival peak and celebrity hot events
celebrity hot events are characterised as abrupt and unforecastable (突发性强无预期) — the prose gives a translation, not a quotation
the DCP capacity target: 1000 nodes in ten minutes
Fu Wen's role: Weibo technical expert, technical lead of the Weibo hybrid-cloud DCP project
two passages from the same writeup, joined by an ellipsis
the writeup lists exactly two classes of peak, which is the 'two kinds' the opening paragraph claims

wangguansheng2016.title: 微博混合云DCP：极端流量下的峰值应对与架构挑战 (Weibo hybrid cloud DCP: meeting peaks and architecture challenges under extreme traffic), 2016 杭州云栖大会 开发者技术峰会
wangguansheng2016.author: 王关胜 (Wang Guansheng), 新浪微博高级运维架构师
wangguansheng2016.quote: 类似王宝强这类非常极端的突发事件导致的核心服务数倍的流量增长 … 各种运营活动以及明星、大V的热门微博所带来的流量高峰 … 瞬间峰值高、互动时间短
supports: a single celebrity event drives several-fold traffic growth on Weibo's core services
the burst profile: very high instantaneous peak, short interaction window
three passages from the same writeup, joined by ellipses

note: this writeup lists THREE peak classes, not two, and contains no 春晚, ECS or 60% figure — the opening paragraph's 'two kinds' and the Fu Wen attribution rest on fuwen2017, which is cited alongside it

aliyun2016.title: 云场景实践研究第13期：新浪微博DCP系统 (Cloud scenario study #13: Sina Weibo's DCP system)
aliyun2016.author: 场景研读, 阿里云云栖社区 (Alibaba Cloud vendor case study; the quoted 'hours before the peak' line is attributed on the page to 陈飞, 新浪微博研发中心技术经理及高级技术专家)
aliyun2016.quote: 2016年春晚，微博与阿里云合作，在流量峰值到来的前几个小时才部署了相应的公有云资源 … 动态创建了1000多个ECS实例，分流了微博60%核心流量 … 整体平均一次扩容的时间小于10分钟
supports: 2016 Spring Festival: more than 1000 Alibaba Cloud ECS instances created dynamically
those instances carried 60% of Weibo's core traffic
average time for one scale-out under 10 minutes
three passages from the same article, joined by ellipses
note: the page foot reads 原文发布日期：2016-04-05 and the community repost header reads 2018-02-03; year/date here are the original publication

whatsonweibo2017.title: Weibo Servers Down After Lu Han Announces New Relationship
whatsonweibo2017.author: Manya Koetse, What's on Weibo
whatsonweibo2017.quote: It was this one-sentence message that set Weibo on fire on Sunday, October 8. … "Hi everyone, I want to introduce my girlfriend @GuanXiaoTong to you." … So many fans commented on Lu Han's new love affair that the social media platform was inaccessible for two hours.
supports: date of the post: Sunday 8 October 2017
the text of Lu Han's post, in this outlet's English rendering
the platform was inaccessible for two hours
three passages from the same article, joined by ellipses

scmp2017.title: Weibo in meltdown over heartthrob Luhan's new girlfriend (South China Morning Post)
scmp2017.author: Laurie Chen
scmp2017.quote: The noon announcement about actress Guan Xiaotong on Luhan's official account sent Weibo's traffic to record levels and paralysed some of its servers. … Server function was fully restored at around 4pm, according to a Weibo programmer.
supports: the post went up at noon
service was fully restored at around 4pm, per a Weibo programmer
two passages from the same article, joined by an ellipsis

unverified: The exact date of Li Chen's '我们' photo post with Fan Bingbing. The allocation brief says 27 May 2015; the 钛媒体 account republished at m.newseed.cn/news/1329316 says 2015年5月29日. The two disagree and no primary source was found, so the 2015 event is not in the prose.

That the 2015 Li Chen / Fan Bingbing post is what caused Weibo to start buying elastic capacity from Alibaba Cloud. It is asserted by tech media (钛媒体) but not by any Weibo engineering source read here, so the causal claim is not made in the prose.

Any monetary figure — the revenue lost during the 8 October 2017 outage, or what Weibo paid Alibaba Cloud for DCP burst capacity. No source read here gives a currency amount, so no money figure is claimed.

Weibo's reported push/pull split in detail — in particular the '在线推、离线拉' design (push only to followers currently online, let the rest pull on connect) and any follower-count threshold at which an account stops being fanned out. Widely repeated in secondary Chinese architecture writeups; not confirmed in any Weibo engineering source opened here, so it is not in the prose.
Engagement counts on Lu Han's post (figures such as 5.65 million likes and 2.83 million comments appear in search summaries). Neither the SCMP nor the What's on Weibo article as read contains them.
Weibo's daily-active-user count at the time of the October 2017 outage.

That Weibo's servers were down for exactly two hours. What's on Weibo says 'inaccessible for two hours'; SCMP says the noon post paralysed some servers and function was fully restored at around 4pm. Both statements are in the prose, attributed separately, rather than being reconciled into one duration.
